record_contract.clock: globaltimer for cross-SM alignment; local cycle counters require explicit anchors

conventions.compiler: nvcc for the requested sm_90, sm_100a, or sm_103a target
conventions.collector: nsys plus GPU metrics; compile and label each architecture separately
conventions.event_ids: Use event_id and event_id_const exactly as declared in knowledge/semantic_ids.json; never 0 and never assign a language-local sequence.
conventions.levels: Measure off, entry-only, and full builds so instrumentation overhead is separable.
conventions.scope_selection: Use the enclosing task boundary to choose task versus phase; source keywords alone do not decide record_scope.
conventions.name_policy: display_name and trace name are the semantic_id; aliases are match-only and never rendered.
conventions.evidence_policy: This file is a reference library. Only a target-card hard run can raise evidence_status to measured.
conventions.safety: Use a fixed per-slot cap and set FI_LEVEL=0/1/2 for off/entry-only/full; cap includes OPEN, CLOSE, and timer anchors. Before delivery check every offset < max_records, every slot < n_slots, FI overflow is zero, and final trace/summary/log SHAs close the run. Never wrap or reuse a full slot.

event_boundaries.begin: Immediately before the first A/B tile load for the selected GEMM segment.
event_boundaries.end: After the final accumulator update and after any async MMA completion wait; the enclosing task span closes after the final C write or the selected segment boundary.

patterns.record_scope: task when the whole kernel segment is a GEMM; phase only when nested inside attention, MoE, convolution, or a fused operator. One span per executed GEMM segment, never one per K tile.
patterns.writer_rule: Exactly one writer per logical recorder: FI_OPEN installs the lane/warp predicate; with FI_GRAN=0 only lane 0 of each physical warp writes (used for Warp-Specialized kernels: if (warp_id < 4) { /* Producer_DMA role=0 */ } else { /* Consumer_MMA role=1 */ } grouped under group="sm"), and with FI_GRAN=1 only the CTA linear thread 0 writes (homogeneous kernels, group="sm_resident"). Inside K-loops use branchless predicated PTX FI_BG_PRED(fi_rec_k_, ev, aux) / FI_EG_PRED(fi_rec_k_, ev, aux) ('@%p mov.u64 %t, %globaltimer; @%p st.global.cs.v4.u32 [%1], {%tlo, %thi, %2, %3};') with overflow atomicOr hoisted to fi_close. Derive warp and lane from linear_tid = threadIdx.x + blockDim.x * (threadIdx.y + blockDim.y * threadIdx.z).
patterns.buffer_rule: Use a fixed per-slot cap and set FI_LEVEL=0/1/2 for off/entry-only/full; cap includes OPEN, CLOSE, and timer anchors. Before delivery check every offset < max_records, every slot < n_slots, FI overflow is zero, and final trace/summary/log SHAs close the run. Never wrap or reuse a full slot.
language_notes: Targets: H20 is nv/sm_90 (measured 57.52 TFLOPS Warp-Specialized GEMM); B300 is nv/sm_100a or nv/sm_103a (measured 179.92 TFLOPS / 190.98 us Warp-Specialized GEMM on sm_103a, 148 SMs, 267 GB HBM3e) and must be compiled and labelled per actual architecture.

FI_B/FI_E/FI_M and branchless predicated FI_BG_PRED(fi_rec_k_, ...)/FI_EG_PRED(fi_rec_k_, ...) arrive through 2_instrument/recorders/cuda_cpp/fi_lite.cuh; event ids are 1..4095 and 0 means an empty record.

For 2-WarpGroup Warp-Specialized GEMM (if (warp_id < 4) { /* Producer_DMA */ } else { /* Consumer_MMA */ }), Producer_DMA warps 0..3 must use cp.async.mbarrier.arrive.noinc.shared.b64 (never omit .noinc, which doubles expected arrival count 128 -> 256 and deadlocks mbarrier.try_wait.parity.shared.b64).
Record an async load, WGMMA, or TMA store end only after the matching wait; an issue-site timestamp is not data-ready evidence.
Keep FI_OPEN and FI_CLOSE on every executed path and keep the same event id/aux pairing for begin and end.

Before delivery check every offset < max_records, every slot < n_slots, FI overflow is zero, and final trace/summary/log SHAs close the run. Never wrap or reuse a full slot.
